subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: For the agents `nodes` tool, should `action: "describe"` without `node` default to one node, return list-style discovery, or remain rejected with clearer tool/schema guidance?
rationale: The current flat schema makes `node` optional, but docs and the gateway API historically require an explicit node for describe; implicit defaulting changes multi-node agent behavior and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Default to the resolved current node
options.body: Land or refine the linked PR’s narrow behavior so `describe` without `node` uses the existing default-node resolver while write-like actions stay explicit.

options.title: Return discovery data instead
options.body: Replace the linked PR with list-style output for no-node `describe` so agents can discover node IDs before targeting a specific node.

options.title: Keep describe explicit
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and repair the agent-facing schema, prompt copy, or action guidance so models stop omitting `node` for `describe`.

recommendation.title: Default to the resolved current node
recommendation.body: Land or refine the linked PR’s narrow behavior so `describe` without `node` uses the existing default-node resolver while write-like actions stay explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the nodes tool schema and current implementation path, making him the best available owner for the behavior-contract choice.
